title: Pure Morganite
summary: Pure Morganite stun and beatdown build, supported by high-impact Normal Summon floodgates and Counter Traps. Centered on Time-Tearing Morganite, Succumbing-Song Morganite, and Morgana the Witch of Eyes, the deck permanently alters Duel rules—trading hand-activated monster effects for double draws, two Normal Summons per turn, doubled battle damage, and double attacks on monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Morgana the Witch of Eyes searches any Morganite Spell from your Deck upon Normal or Special Summon, and can reduce an attacking opposing monster's ATK to 0.

Time-Tearing Morganite rewrites the Duel rules: for the rest of the Duel, you cannot activate monster effects in the hand, you draw two cards per Draw Phase, and you can conduct two Normal Summons or Sets each turn.

Succumbing-Song Morganite banishes itself from the GY to search any Morganite card, prevents hand monster effects, doubles all battle damage you inflict, and allows your monsters to make up to two attacks on monsters.
Pot of Duality excavates the top three cards of your Deck to add one, running without downside in a deck that never Special Summons.
Card of Demise draws up to three cards, digging deep into floodgates and counter traps before setting your backrow.

summary.title: Opening: Time-Tearing Morganite + Inspector Boarder
steps: Activate Time-Tearing Morganite, immediately granting an extra Normal Summon for the turn and establishing two draws per turn for the rest of the Duel.
Normal Summon Inspector Boarder to immediately shut down field-activated monster effects based on monster card types in play.
Use your second Normal Summon to summon Thunder King Rai-Oh, Amano-Iwato, or Morgana the Witch of Eyes (searching Succumbing-Song Morganite).
Equip Moon Mirror Shield to Inspector Boarder, ensuring it cannot be overcome in battle.
Set your Counter Traps (Solemn Judgment, Solemn Strike, Solemn Warning) to protect your floodgates from removal.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Inspector Boarder completely restricts monster effect activations on the field, locking opponents out of initiating combos.
Thunder King Rai-Oh prevents cards from being added from the Main Deck to the hand except by drawing, and Tributes itself to negate a Special Summon.
Amano-Iwato prevents either player from activating monster effects, creating total monster shutdown.
Morgana the Witch of Eyes searches engine Spells and reduces opposing monsters' ATK to 0 when they declare an attack.
Moon Mirror Shield guarantees that your floodgate monsters win any battle by setting their ATK to 100 higher than the opposing monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Time-Tearing Morganite permanently generates an additional draw per turn and an extra Normal Summon every turn.
Succumbing-Song Morganite doubles battle damage, grants double attacks on monsters, and banishes itself from the GY to search Morganite cards.
Pot of Duality and Card of Demise provide unmatched draw power tailored to a non-Special Summoning strategy.
Solemn Judgment, Solemn Strike, and Solemn Warning form an ironclad defense against opponent board breakers and summon attempts.
